description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the MessageHeaders interface, providing accessors for message header information such as direction, subject, thing entity ID, feature ID, timestamp, and status code. It extends AbstractDittoHeaders and offers static methods for instantiation.

classes.name: ImmutableMessageHeaders
classes.description: An immutable implementation of MessageHeaders that encapsulates message header data and provides methods to access specific header fields.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ImmutableMessageHeaders by wrapping the provided DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Retrieves the message direction from headers, converting the header value to MessageDirection enum.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject header value, throws if absent.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID header value if present.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Parses and returns the timestamp from headers as OffsetDateTime.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Parses and returns the HTTP status code from headers.

methods.name: getSpecificDefinitionByKey
methods.description: Fetches a header definition by key, prioritizing custom definitions over standard message headers.
